subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Solves verbally stated addition and subtraction story sums in the range 1-8 with counters

show.line: Story sums to eight! Five brooms and three more brooms. Count them all. Eight brooms!

rounds.story: Bongani helps carry four bags. His sister carries two bags. How many bags altogether?
rounds.praise: Six! Four and two is six.

rounds.prompt: Three plates and four plates. Count them all.

rounds.story: There are eight socks on the line. Mama takes down three. How many are still on the line?
rounds.praise: Five! Eight take away three is five.

rounds.prompt: Six coins in the money box. I put in two more. How many now? Say the number.

rounds.story: Seven children help sweep. Two go to fetch water. How many are still sweeping?
rounds.praise: Five! Seven take away two is five.

rounds.prompt: Two spoons and six spoons. How many spoons altogether?

hints: More means count on. Take away means count what is left.
Use your fingers to help you count.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Five cups and two more cups.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Five and two more. That makes six cups!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Five and two more is seven.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count on together. Five, six, seven!

parent_line: Can solve adding and taking away stories up to 8.
